title: Citrus County Education: 971 multiracial students were enrolled in only school district in 2023-24 school year | Nature Coast Times
text:
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Florida Department of Education.
Data showed that Citrus County welcomed a total of 15,889 students at the time. Among them, multiracial students comprised 6.1% of the student body to be the third most represented ethnicity in the county. The most represented ethnicity was white, accounting for 76.1% of the students (12,092), followed by Hispanic students who made up 11.5% of the student population (1,832).
Gov. DeSantis has approved an education budget of over $28 billion for the 2024-25 school year. The new budget includes more than $1 billion earmarked exclusively for teacher salaries to better address the teacher shortage the state faces.
According to the National Education Association (NEA), Florida ranks 50th in the U.S. in terms of teacher salaries, only ahead of West Virginia.
District | No. of multiracial Students | Total District Enrollment | % of Total Enrollment |
---|---|---|---|
Citrus County School District | 971 | 15,889 | 6.1% |
